title: Tenant cohort feature-pivot retention mart (daily incremental)
creator: Marcos Rivera
description: Build a nightly incremental materialized mart that produces tenant-level cohort retention and feature-usage pivots. Goal: provide fast slices for product and growth teams to answer questions like "what percent of tenants who adopted feature X on day 0 are still actively invoking routes on day N" and to attribute incremental cost to feature adoption. This mart will be optimized for ad-hoc console dashboards and short-range cohort queries (0-90 days), with space-efficient encodings for sparse features.
background: Current console analytics provide per-invocation and route aggregates but lack a pre-curated, pivoted view that ties tenant cohorts (by first-invocation date or signup) to per-feature exposure and retention over day offsets. Existing tables require expensive pivot-time processing in dashboards, causing slow queries and duplicated compute. Several product requests (Growth weekly deck, Support escalations) have been delayed due to slow query turnaround.
proposed_tables_schema:
Primary mart: tenant_cohort_feature_pivot_daily
- tenant_id STRING
- cohort_date DATE  -- date of first observed route invocation (tenant-level)
- day_offset INT  -- 0..90
- active_invocations INT  -- unique invocation count for tenants in this cohort on cohort_date + day_offset
- active_routes_count INT  -- distinct console routes touched
- unique_actors INT  -- unique user_ids or API tokens (best-effort)
- features_present ARRAY<STRING>  -- list of feature flags observed (stored as compressed CSV in string for shrinkage)
- feature_pct_map STRING  -- CSV pairs feature:percent_active (pivoted summary to avoid wide columns)
- estimated_token_cost_usd STRING  -- daily estimated cost for cohort-day (rounded string for simplicity)
- bytes_processed_est BIGINT
- last_updated TIMESTAMP
Partitioning: RANGE partition by cohort_date monthly (or ingestion_date).
Clustering: cluster on tenant_id, day_offset for fast per-tenant and per-offset queries.
Storage encoding: compress features_present and feature_pct_map using snappy at ingestion; retain a narrow companion table tenant_cohort_feature_narrow for full time-series debugging.
Materialization frequency: nightly incremental job that ingests previous 7 days as sliding window and backfills missing earlier cohorts during bootstrap.
Retention: 13 months of hot partitions, older archived to cheaper storage (export to GCS as parquet).
acceptance_criteria: Nightly materialization completes within SLA (<= 2 hours) for 90-day sliding window
Common dashboard queries (growth 7d cohort retention pivot) respond < 8s using the mart only
Space usage for hot 90-day partitions < 250 GB after compression for current tenant set
Backfill plan validated on sample tenant set (<= 7 day runtime for 1 month of data)
migration_plan: 1) Create tenant_cohort_feature_pivot_daily as a staging table and run one-week dry-run. 2) Validate counts against canonical invocation fact (run reconciliation queries). 3) Switch downstream dashboards to query the mart with a feature-flag toggle. 4) Keep narrow debug table for 30 days before TTL-ing. 5) Monitor jobs and set alerts for >2x cardinality deltas vs canonical facts.
tradeoffs_and_decisions: We evaluated two shapes: wide pivot (one boolean column per feature) vs CSV-compressed pivot map. Wide pivot improves simple filtering but explodes schema with client feature permutations; compressed pivot reduces width and storage but requires extraction during advanced queries. Decision: compressed pivot + companion narrow table. Also chose monthly partitioning on cohort_date instead of daily to reduce partition explosion given tenants with sparse cohorts.
runbook:
- Monitor nightly job in Airflow (task: cohort_pivot.materialize).
- On job failure: inspect worker logs in GCS and re-run with --start-date set to failed cohort_date.
- For stale partitions: trigger re-materialize for cohort_date range via tooling.
- Emergency rollback: set dashboard feature-flag to read from canonical invocation fact for 24h, open incident ticket ENG-rollback-51379.

2026-03-02: Infra suggested monthly partitions and clustering — accepted. Added companion narrow debug table to workflow.
2026-03-08: PR opened for SQL DAG and materialization logic (see links). Running full month backfill in staging (expected finish 2026-03-11).
notes: Plan includes one test query template for product dashboards, and an alternate narrow table path for ad-hoc deep dives. Keep an eye on cardinality growth if new feature flags are released rapidly; add automations to cap the number of distinct features per tenant or fall back to top-K features per-tenant extraction.
